owner_approval: User-directed in the active RFC 0018 workstream
reason: The graph-cut replay pairs take a long time; the owner requested reducing the required sample from 20 pairs to 10.

selection.rule: Evaluate the first 10 primary held-out seeds in the unchanged frozen registry, in registry order.

revised_pass_conditions: Complete both baseline and graph arms for the first 10 primary held-out seeds in the frozen registry
No more than one of those 10 seeds has D_s < 0; D_s = 0 counts as non-worsening
At least 50 combined actual split events across those 10 pairs
unchanged: D_s = baseline tiny-split count minus graph tiny-split count; tiny means smaller daughter area below 7% of parent area
200 Myr per arm and the same simulation settings, random streams, and candidate method
The frozen registry and seed order
Descriptive reporting of mean D_s, paired seed-bootstrap interval, improved-seed count, tiny-split shares, and daughter distributions

post_result_amendment.interpretation: Owner-directed post-result amendment; the ten-pair result is not confirmatory and supports non-worsening only, not positive efficacy. The smaller sample has less precision.

excluded_observation: Seed 205240614 has a completed baseline arm but no graph arm. It is unpaired and outside the first ten registry seeds, so it is excluded from this gate.
